This petition under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. is filed by accused No.3 in Crime No.150/2010 registered by Hubali Town Police Station, Dharwad District for the offence punishable under Section 489(A)(B)(C) and 420 of IPC.

entities.text: Hubali Town Police Station, Dharwad District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3.

The material on record would go to show that a split up case has been registered against accused Nos.3 and 4 in Criminal Case No.464/2011 and in the said case, the Trial Court has issued non-bailable warrant and proclamation order against the absconding accused namely accused Nos.3 and 4.
4.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Pradeep Sharma,
reported in (2014) 2 SCC 171

entities.text:
State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Pradeep Sharma,
reported in (2014) 2 SCC 171
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: , has observed that anticipatory bail application in a case where proclamation order is issued by the Trial Court cannot be entertained.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made in the present petition by the petitioner seeking anticipatory bail cannot be granted.
Registry is directed to return the certified copies of the orders produced by the learned counsel for the petitioner after retaining the photo stat copy of the same.

Sd/-
